newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate surges as liquidity tightens.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate surges as liquidity tightens.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate rose sharply in late Friday morning trade on sharply tightened liquidity stemming from heavy dollar buying and high seasonal demand for funds ahead of the Lunar new year, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate was quoted in a 15.00-17.00 percent range in late morning against 13.50-14.00 earlier in the morning, dealers said.
"Some banks were heard offering the overnight rate at 20 percent. But the market still waits for a clearer picture," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
The market saw active dollar buying on Friday on lingering concern about baht devaluation rumours and after the central bank released mixed economic indicators on Thursday, dealers said.
Another dealer at a Thai bank said absence of fund injection by the Bank of Thailand this morning also boosted demand for baht funds.
The central bank said trade and current account deficits narrowed sharply in November but the balance of payments posted a hefty deficit in December.
